content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DDMCH Kendujhar Assistant Surgeon recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview on the specified date, which is 09 September 2026. There is no separate application form submission deadline mentioned.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Assistant Surgeon post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS Degree or an equivalent qualification recognized by the Medical Council of India (MCI) or the National Medical Commission (NMC). A completed compulsory one-year rotating internship is also mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Assistant Surgeon position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Assistant Surgeon post is 45 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Surgeon post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 80,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant Surgeon post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies announced for the Assistant Surgeon position at Darranidhar Medical College & Hospital Kendujhar.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the DDMCH Kendujhar Assistant Surgeon recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Walk-in Interview, followed by Document Verification. A merit list will be prepared based on the career marks of the candidates.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies of educational certificates, ID proof, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates (if applicable), along with recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the Walk-in Interview scheduled to be held?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview will be held at Dharanidhar Medical College & Hospital Kendujhar, Odisha, PIN 758001.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The recruitment for the Assistant Surgeon post is on a contractual basis.
